snippet.title: 3 Heroes, 1 Shared Deck. This Roguelike is GENIUS!
snippet.description:
Northanda Chronicles is the ULTIMATE party-based deckbuilder roguelike, blending multi-hero synergy with gem-enhanced card customization! Build a team of Defender, Slayer, and Support, merge their decks into one tactical engine, and adapt your strategy through battles, events, and upgrades. Think Slay the Spire meets Darkest Dungeon in a clean fantasy world – and every decision can snowball into something completely broken.

🌟 Northanda Chronicles On Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068650/Northanda_Chronicles/

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Join My New Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/wBNSzJSuRz

🚀 WHY I LIKED IT:
✔️ Party Deckbuilding – Combine three heroes into one evolving strategy.
✔️ Gem System – Modify cards mid-run for insane scaling potential.
✔️ Tactical Combat – Enemy intent + positioning creates meaningful decisions.
✔️ Meta Progression – Unlock new cards and expand build possibilities.

📍 Chapter Timestamps:
00:00 - (Subscribe! 🔔) A NEW Party Deckbuilder Roguelike?!
04:10 - Learning The Three Hero System ⚔️🛡️
08:25 - First Real Synergy Decisions 🧠
12:40 - Gems Start Changing The Build 💎
17:05 - Risky Event… Worth The Damage? 😬
21:20 - Counter Mechanics & Smart Plays 💥
25:30 - Deck Starts Scaling Properly 📈
30:05 - Tangled Yarn Changes EVERYTHING 🧵
34:40 - Shop Choices & Build Direction 💰
39:10 - Stealth + Ambush Combo Online 🥷
43:45 - Lightning Spear Carry Begins ⚡
48:20 - Final Prep Before Boss Fight 🛠️
51:30 - Boss Fight: Living Armor Nightmare 🌳👹
54:30 - Run Wrap-Up & Build Verdict 🎯
